rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for soil or loose earth.

example.english: The dirt in the garden is all wet.
example.jyutping: faa1 jyun4 di1 nai4 sap1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a visible stain or mark on clothing, furniture, or another surface.

example.english: This shirt has a dirt stain that won't wash out.
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 jau5 wu1 zik1 sai2 m4 lat1

rows.note: Use this for accumulated grime or a dirty foreign substance rather than one isolated stain.

example.english: This machine has accumulated a lot of dirt.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 wu1 gau3

rows.note: Use this for compromising facts or rumors about a person, especially in media or online talk.

example.english: Dirt about him is circulating online.
example.jyutping: mong5 soeng6 lau4 cyun4 gan2 keoi5 ge3 hak1 liu2
